parameters.query:
SELECT name, decrypted_secret,
  encode(hmac(decode($1, 'base64'), decrypted_secret::bytea, 'sha256'), 'base64') AS computed_hmac
FROM vault.decrypted_secrets
WHERE name LIKE 'shopify_webhook_secret_LOC_%'

INSERT INTO public.raw_orders (source, external_ref, location_key, shopify_order_id, received_at, headers, raw_payload, hmac_valid) VALUES ('shopify'::public.order_source, $1, $2, $3::bigint, now(), $4::jsonb, $5::jsonb, true) ON CONFLICT (shopify_order_id, location_key) DO UPDATE SET received_at = now(), raw_payload = EXCLUDED.raw_payload, headers = EXCLUDED.headers RETURNING id
